title: Recovering the spatiotemporally dependent diffusion and advection coefficients in a pathway-based Keller--Segel model
summary: We investigate an inverse coefficient problem for an augmented Keller--Segel model arising in the description of phototactic and chemotactic population dynamics. The spatiotemporal evolution of the population density is governed by an advection-diffusion equation in which both the diffusion coefficient and the advection coefficient depend on space and time.
